query:
WITH input(name) AS (
                    SELECT DISTINCT val
                    FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS data(val)
                )
                INSERT INTO authors (name, sort_name)
                SELECT name, NULL
                FROM input
                ON CONFLICT (name)
                DO UPDATE
                SET sort_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sort_name, authors.sort_name)
                RETURNING name, id
